exercises.name: Basic Phrasing over Malfuf 1
exercises.notes:
Basic Phrasing over Malfuf, part 1. One sequence: 8 exercises forward, then the same 8 back with reverse dynamics, 16 rows.

Two aims at once: simple phrasing over Malfuf, and applying the fingering of the numbers.
Every exercise goes over 2 bars. Bar 1 is always Malfuf: D - - T - - T - (3 + 3 + 2). Bar 2 splits the 8 cells into two groups: 7 + 1, 6 + 2, 5 + 3 ... down to 8.

FORWARD: the first group is DUM plus ghost notes, the second group is strong high notes (TAK and KA, played strong).
Example 5 + 3: DUM and four ghost notes (a group of five), then three strong high notes. Count it aloud: "dum 2 3 4 5, 1 2 3".

REVERSE DYNAMICS: turned around. The strong high notes come first, then the DUM and the ghost notes. The DUM lands later and later, until 1 + 7: one TAK, then the DUM.

T is the strong hand, K is the weaker hand: the letters already tell you the fingering.

Nothing is new here. There is no new combination of fingering: we only combine groups we already know and change the dynamics. If you do not remember the fingering of six, go back to the fingerings lesson (GHOST NOTES FOR EVEN NUMBERS / UNEVEN NUMBERS) and the short videos.

1 + 7 looks strange: play a DUM, then the fingering of SEVEN, starting again with the strong hand. Why not simply the fingering of eight? It would be the same melody. Because we establish the mechanism of a DUM and then starting a new idea again with the strong hand. For now it does not make sense; later we play combinations that start with a DUM and again with the strong hand, and then we need that ability.

8 has no DUM in bar 2: eight strong high notes, the fingering of eight. It is the turning point: forward ends on it, reverse starts from it.

Go slow first. Keep the order of the fingers: right, left, right ... (Mantreshwar to a student: "you are confusing the order of the fingering again").

The fingering of bar 2 (S strong hand, i index, r ring of the weaker hand):
FORWARD
1. D - - - - - - T   S i S r S i r | S   (7 + 1)
2. D - - - - - T K   S i S r S i | S i   (6 + 2)
3. D - - - - T K K   S i S i r | S i r   (5 + 3)
4. D - - - T K T K   S i S r | S i S r   (4 + 4)
5. D - - T K T K K   S i r | S i S i r   (3 + 5)
6. D - T K T K T K   S i | S i S r S i   (2 + 6)
7. D T K T K T K K   S | S i S r S i r   (1 + 7)
8. T K T K T K T K   S i S r S i S r   (8)
REVERSE DYNAMICS
1. T K T K T K T K   S i S r S i S r   (8)
2. T K T K T K K D   S i S r S i r | S   (7 + 1)
3. T K T K T K D -   S i S r S i | S i   (6 + 2)
4. T K T K K D - -   S i S i r | S i r   (5 + 3)
5. T K T K D - - -   S i S r | S i S r   (4 + 4)
6. T K K D - - - -   S i r | S i S i r   (3 + 5)
7. T K D - - - - -   S i | S i S r S i   (2 + 6)
8. T D - - - - - -   S | S i S r S i r   (1 + 7)
